app.name: SmartDepo
app.tagline: Manage your depot's products, stock, sales, and customer credit in one place.

auth.loginSubtitle: Use the email address or phone number registered with your depot.
auth.registerSubtitle: Send your details to the Platform Admin. You can sign in after your depot is approved.
auth.noAccount: Do not have a depot account?
auth.depotNamePlaceholder: For example, Boeng Keng Kong Depot
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number.
auth.loginExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.sessionSuspended: Your depot has been suspended. Contact the Platform Admin for help.
auth.sessionRejected: Your depot registration was rejected. Contact the Platform Admin for help.
auth.sessionPending: Your depot is still waiting for approval.
auth.loginGenericError: We could not sign you in. Check your details and try again.

validation.passwordLength: Password must be between 8 and 72 characters.
validation.passwordComplexity: Password must contain at least one letter and one number.
validation.reasonLength: Enter a reason between 3 and 500 characters.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.subtitle: Your depot registration is with the Platform Admin.
pending.registeredTitle: Thank you. Your depot is registered.
pending.registeredMessage: The Platform Admin will review your details. You can sign in after the depot is approved.
pending.stepReview: The Platform Admin reviews your depot information.
pending.stepDecision: You receive approval, or the registration is rejected with a reason.
pending.stepSignIn: After approval, sign in with your owner email or phone.
pending.checkLater: You can close this page. Your registration is saved.

rejected.title: Registration not approved
rejected.message: The Platform Admin did not approve this depot registration. Depot users cannot sign in while the registration is rejected.
rejected.next: Contact the Platform Admin if you need more information or want to correct your details.
rejected.contact: Please have your depot name, owner name, and phone number ready when you contact the Platform Admin.

suspended.title: Depot suspended
suspended.message: This depot has been suspended. Depot users cannot sign in and active sessions are ended when they refresh.
suspended.next: Contact the Platform Admin to resolve the suspension.
suspended.contact: Please have your depot name and owner details ready when you contact the Platform Admin.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.message: Your role cannot open this page. The server also enforces this permission.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: This is your depot workspace. More modules arrive in the next phases.
dashboard.workspaceReadyBody: Your account and depot are connected. Products, stock, customers, invoices, and reports will appear here as they are built.
dashboard.quickActionsEmpty: No actions are available for your role yet.
dashboard.upcomingBody: Product and unit management, stock movements, customers and credit, invoices and payments, suppliers, and reports.
dashboard.emptyBody: This workspace has no records to show.

platform.title: Depot review
platform.subtitle: Review registrations and manage depot access. Changes are recorded in the audit log.
platform.approveMessage: "{name}" will be able to sign in and use its depot workspace.
platform.rejectMessage: Users of "{name}" will not be able to sign in. Give a clear reason for the audit log.
platform.suspendMessage: Users of "{name}" will not be able to sign in or refresh their session. Give a clear reason for the audit log.
platform.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the decision for the audit log
platform.emptyBody: There are no depots with this status.
platform.loadError: We could not load the depot list.
platform.actionError: The action could not be completed.

errors.network: We cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to do this.
errors.notFound: The requested record was not found.
errors.conflict: This action conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.
errors.identifierTaken: That email address or phone number is already registered.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.server: The server had a problem. Try again shortly.
